author: cursor
original: [out-of-contract] 本地与发布路径的版本串前导 v 不一致。本仓库实测 `git describe --tags` 输出 v20260908T154432Z-7466cd6acfd3-21-g96ddc88, Makefile:10 原样注入; release.yml:31 用 ${GITHUB_REF_NAME#v} 剥掉前导 v。结果是同一个 v0.5.0 提交, 本地 make 的二进制报 `kander v0.5.0`, release 二进制报 `kander 0.5.0`。EXPECTED_OUTCOME 只要求本地版本来自 `git describe --tags --always`, 因此实现合规, 仅是两侧展示不一致。最小改动: 在 Makefile:10 与 make-windows.cmd:13-19 的默认值上剥掉前导 v (如 VERSION := $(VERSION:v%=%))。
basis: Matches EXPECTED_OUTCOME: local make version comes from git describe --tags --always as-is; release strips the leading v via ${GITHUB_REF_NAME#v}. Stripping v in Makefile would change the stated local default. Observed describe output on this repo starts with v; not a defect in this card.
